title: extension.edges@1
description: What a manifest declares about other pieces, beside extension.manifest@1, whose frozen shape doesn't list it: the packages it conflicts with, so an install beside an installed one is refused naming the conflict, and the kernel contract versions it runs on, each a contract entry the kernel must publish.

items.description: A package's owner/name ID: neither installs while the other is installed.
A kernel contract version the package runs on, as name@major: the install is refused when the kernel doesn't publish it.
